bench-ext10-aot: The aot arm of the overhead bench: its subject is the ten TypeScript extensions the aot runtime compiles, so they cannot be Go.
bench-ext10-split: The split arm of the overhead bench: five of the ten extensions are the TypeScript originals the aot runtime compiles, so they cannot be Go.
pig-autolith: Its one extension, autolith-bridge, is Common Lisp on the PiG 0.7.0 Lisp SDK: it is the point of the Piglet (a bridge to Autolith, itself Common Lisp). PiG builds it into a cached SBCL image instead of fusing it into the Binary.
